facts: VoiceOutputPacket binds the full text_segment, planned_audio_duration_ms, playback_state, heard_fraction, interruption_ms and commit_eligible.
advance_output permits monotonic heard_fraction and marks commit_eligible only for playback_state=completed with heard_fraction=1.0.
The current packet contract does not bind a word/token/phoneme/audio-frame alignment, an exact heard-prefix text value, or a heard-prefix digest for a partially heard text_segment.

pinned_hf_observation.fact: ConversationItemTruncateEvent is parsed and accepted for WebSocket, but the router intentionally performs no additional server-state mutation because it assumes response cancellation/server-VAD already discarded provisional generation and client playback owns the unheard tail.

current_primary_reference_behavior.finding: Current RealtimeSession interruption handling updates history so server-side conversation stays aligned with what the user actually heard; delayed playback should provide tracked playback position.
Current WebSocket interruption handling truncates assistant audio/history to what the user actually heard and updates local history from truncation/conversation events.
Current interruption handling truncates conversation history to only the portion of agent speech heard before interruption.

new_high_information_finding.finding: A scalar heard_fraction over a full text_segment is insufficient to derive the exact semantic text prefix heard by the user. Speech duration is not proportional to character/token count, and TTS prosody, pauses, punctuation, numbers and tokenization make fraction-based text slicing non-evidential.
new_high_information_finding.forbidden_implementation: Do not derive heard_prefix_text by multiplying heard_fraction or interruption_ms by character/token length unless an independently validated alignment transform explicitly binds that mapping.
new_high_information_finding.why_it_matters: Without an explicit alignment witness, a RETAIN_HEARD_PREFIX policy can silently keep unheard semantics or delete heard semantics, corrupting next-turn context while appearing numerically precise.

rules: Retain only assistant semantics proven to be within the measured playout/heard boundary.
Always exclude the unheard tail from ephemeral next-turn context.
Keep interrupted output non-commit-eligible for durable VoiceOutcome/UnifiedDB/effect purposes unless separately admitted.
At packet boundaries, fully heard completed earlier packets may be retained directly.
For a partially heard current packet, retain partial text only when a word/token/phoneme/segment alignment witness maps the measured audio boundary to an exact text-prefix boundary.
If no such alignment exists, fail closed: omit the unverifiable partial packet from semantic next-turn context rather than inventing a fractional string cut.
Reduce lost heard semantics by making output semantic/audio segments small and causally acknowledged, not by guessing alignment.

required_additional_classification: If whole completed assistant text remains in the next-turn server/model context after only a prefix was actually heard, classify as protocol context divergence under a pinned heard-prefix policy.

If the local adapter deletes the whole interrupted response, do not call that a product negative until product authority pins heard-prefix retention; report exact deletion behavior and dialogue-coherence impact.
If partial text is claimed retained, require alignment receipt; scalar heard_fraction alone is insufficient evidence.

next_exact_action: Keep the existing HF10 controller-routed execution lane. Before classifying partial interrupted-context retention as correct, bind a product policy and require an audio-to-text alignment witness for any partially heard packet. Route this alignment precondition to Trigger4 without opening a duplicate runtime dispatch or reopening accepted WP715.
